profile.grounding_note: Simulated coaching profile grounded in real StudentLife pre-term surveys (PSS=20.0, PHQ-9=5.0, UCLA Loneliness=55.0, PHQ-9 item 9=1, Extraversion=1.75, Neuroticism=3.62, Conscientiousness=3.44); courses: COSC 050, COSC 065, FILM 051.
goals: Manage overwhelm during clustered CS 50, CS 65, and FILM 51 deadlines by chunking tasks
Stay connected with supportive peers or campus resources when feeling isolated or stressed
Maintain steady ~7.5h sleep routine across midterm and late-term weeks

preferences.activity_style: Gentle walks, Ultimate Frisbee / light outdoor air, or low-pressure 1-on-1 check-ins

constraints: Elevated baseline loneliness (UCLA=55.0) and moderate perceived stress (PSS=20.0); pre-term PHQ-9 item 9=1 requires warm resource awareness when stress peaks at 5/5
Enrolled in COSC 050, COSC 065, and FILM 051

episodes.final_message: Handling 3 deadlines today alongside a blizzard of emotions can feel really overwhelming. Instead of tackling everything at once tonight, try shrinking the target: pick just one priority deliverable and spend a low-pressure 25 minutes on a single sub-task, then take a quick break to rest your mind.
